sources.title: AFI Catalog: Forrest Gump (1994)
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected cast, history, production credits and synopsis.
supports: Tom Hanks is credited as Forrest Gump.
The film is based on Winston Groom's 1986 novel.
The Lieutenant Dan wheelchair illusion and digitally added ping-pong balls are documented craft details.
limits: AFI's film synopsis is a record of fictional narrative, not evidence that depicted historical events happened as portrayed.
Its history section summarizes contemporary reporting rather than serving as a production ledger.

source_link.title: AFI Catalog: «Форрест Гамп» (1994)
source_link.supports: Подтверждает Том Хэнкс—Форрест Гамп, литературный источник и конкретные приёмы с визуальными эффектами.

sources.organisation: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
sources.title: Academy: The 67th Academy Awards Memorable Moments
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected Forrest Gump award record.
supports: The Academy records Best Picture and five additional wins for the film.
Tom Hanks won the leading-actor award for Forrest Gump.
limits: The page establishes Academy recognition, not historical accuracy of the film's fiction.

source_link.title: Academy: 67-я церемония «Оскара» — ключевые моменты
source_link.supports: Подтверждает победы фильма, включая награду Тому Хэнксу за главную роль.

sources.title: AFI Catalog: The Shining (1980)
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected credits, history and synopsis.
supports: Jack Nicholson is credited as Jack Torrance, with Shelley Duvall as Wendy and Danny Lloyd as Danny.
The film credits Stanley Kubrick and Diane Johnson as writers.
AFI records the final epilogue removal after preview screenings.
limits: The documented removal does not settle the film's interpretation.
The source concerns Kubrick's 1980 film, not the 1997 television adaptation.

source_link.title: AFI Catalog: «Сияние» (1980)
source_link.supports: Подтверждает Николсон—Джек Торранс, авторов фильма и факт удаления финального эпилога.

sources.title: Stephen King: The Shining (film)
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected official film synopsis and credits.
supports: The page identifies Kubrick as director and Nicholson as Jack Torrance.
It describes Jack's winter-caretaker job at the Overlook and Danny's psychic gift as the shining.
limits: An author-site synopsis is concise and should not be used for claims beyond the described premise.

source_link.title: Stephen King: «Сияние» — фильм
source_link.supports: Подтверждает зимнюю работу Джека в «Оверлуке» и способность Дэнни, называемую сиянием.

sources.title: AFI Catalog: E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial (1982)
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected history, production detail and synopsis.
supports: The production used working titles including A Boy's Life and E.T. and Me.
AFI documents three soundstages for the family rooms, house/backyard and forest landing set.
Principal photography began in September 1981 and was followed by additional January-February 1982 filming.
limits: Use its production chronology as reported production history, not as a reason to embellish the fictional plot.

source_link.title: AFI Catalog: «Инопланетянин» (1982)
source_link.supports: Подтверждает рабочие названия и устройство основных павильонных декораций.

sources.organisation: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
sources.title: Academy: E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial (Prime Tech event)
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected cast, premise, craft and awards record.
supports: Henry Thomas plays Elliott, who forms a relationship with an alien trying to return home.
The Academy identifies Ben Burtt's voice design and animatronic work as key to the character.
The film won Academy Awards for original score, sound, sound-effects editing and visual effects.
limits: The event description is an institutional retrospective, not a complete production history.

source_link.title: Academy: «Инопланетянин» — Prime Tech
source_link.supports: Подтверждает Генри Томас—Эллиотт, дружбу с инопланетянином и работу над голосом, аниматроникой и звуком.

sources.organisation: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
sources.title: Academy: The Art of Costume Design: Black Panther (2018)
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected synopsis, credits and costume-design explanation.
supports: The Academy describes T'Challa as Wakanda's newly crowned king and Black Panther.
It describes Wakanda as technologically advanced and hidden from the outside world.
It documents Ruth E. Carter's Afrofuturist costume approach and her Academy Award for the film.
limits: The page is an Academy event description; Wakanda is a fictional setting, not a real African country.

source_link.title: Academy: искусство костюма в «Чёрной Пантере» (2018)
source_link.supports: Подтверждает статус Т’Чаллы, вымышленную Ваканду и дизайнерский подход Рут Картер.

sources.title: BFI: Black Panther (2018)
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected film record and credits.
supports: The BFI lists Ryan Coogler as director and Chadwick Boseman among the featured cast.
It identifies the film as a 2018 US production.
limits: The compact record does not name Boseman's character; use the BFI interview or Academy page for the role-to-character connection.

source_link.title: BFI: «Чёрная Пантера» (2018)
source_link.supports: Подтверждает фильм 2018 года, режиссуру Райана Куглера и участие Чедвика Боузмана.

sources.title: BFI: Black Panther and a black Bond? Ryan Coogler on his favourite film and influences
sources.access_method: Direct web open; inspected interview with Ryan Coogler.
supports: The interview explicitly identifies Boseman as T'Challa, king of the fictional Wakanda.
It describes the threats posed by Erik Killmonger and Ulysses Klaue.
Coogler identifies the ancient Mali empire and nature documentaries among influences on Wakanda's design.
limits: Coogler's influence comments are first-person creative intent, not proof that Wakanda represents one real culture or country.

source_link.title: BFI: Райан Куглер о влияниях на «Чёрную Пантеру»
source_link.supports: Подтверждает Боузман—Т’Чалла и творческие источники дизайна Ваканды со слов режиссёра.
